title: Free tool: find out how much money your algo strategy is losing to bad execution — not bad strategy
author: Then_Aide_7531
selftext:
Hey, I'm Afsal — building this solo as my first project.



Quick question for algo traders: do you know how much profit disappears not because your strategy is wrong, but because of what happens after it decides to trade — between the signal and the actual fill?



That gap is real money, even for good strategies. It comes from things like:

\- The price moving before your order fills

\- Only getting part of the quantity you wanted

\- Orders getting rejected and never happening at all



I built a free tool that measures exactly this, using your own trading data. (Attaching a sample report below so you can see what it actually looks like.)



All I need: your strategy running paper trading and live trading at the same time. Paper shows what it wanted to do, live shows what actually happened — comparing the two tells you exactly where the money's leaking. If you're not already running both, no problem — start a paper deployment today, and check back with me in 2 weeks.



Just need the trade details — symbol, quantity, price, timing. Not your account number or any personal info, and you don't need to worry about the exact format, I'll sort that out with you.



Not sure if you qualify, or how to get the file? Reply here and I'll help you check, takes 2 minutes.



All I want in return: honest feedback on whether the report was actually useful, and whether you'd have paid for it.



Works best with Tradetron right now, but message me even if you're on something else.
